name: cfg-provider-retry
about: model.providers.<id>.retry 各键对流式请求的作用（model/config/parseModelConfig.ts:170-190 parseRetryConfig；model/policy/RetryPolicy.ts:38-51；model/streaming/streamModel.ts:266、660-693、1132-1140）：streamIdleTimeoutMs=300 时挂住的流按空闲超时出错；maxStreamingDurationMs=150 配挂住 600ms 后断开的流（基线两侧都报 terminated：假 provider 一次写完全部块，最长时长只在收到下一个事件或流正常结束时检查，这里只证明配置合法、不会改变断流结果；正向触发需要采集器支持块间延迟）；repeatedChunkLimit=3 时连续 3 个相同文本块出错（再配 streamMaxRetries=1 看重试后的续写请求）；maxDelayMs=5 压住 baseDelayMs=20000 的退避（步骤限时 6 秒，忽略 maxDelayMs 会超时）；baseDelayMs=1 让 3 次重试很快结束（缺省退避至少 3 秒，步骤限时 2.5 秒）；requestMaxRetries=1 + timeoutMs=600 作用于非流式的标题生成（标题请求挂 1.5 秒，超时后重试 1 次，provider 收到 2 次标题请求）。jitter 只影响随机退避时长，这里只在 jitter=0 时让时长确定。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    pidle:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/pidle/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        streamIdleTimeoutMs: 300
        streamMaxRetries: 0
      models:
        m:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    pdur:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/pdur/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        maxStreamingDurationMs: 150
        streamMaxRetries: 0
      models:
        m:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    prep:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/prep/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        repeatedChunkLimit: 3
        streamMaxRetries: 0
      models:
        m:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    prep2:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/prep2/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        repeatedChunkLimit: 3
        streamMaxRetries: 1
        baseDelayMs: 1
        jitter: 0
      models:
        m:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    pmaxd:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/pmaxd/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        streamMaxRetries: 2
        baseDelayMs: 20000
        jitter: 0
        maxDelayMs: 5
      models:
        m:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    pbase:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/pbase/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        streamMaxRetries: 3
        baseDelayMs: 1
        maxDelayMs: 60000
      models:
        m:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    preq:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/preq/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      timeoutMs: 600
      retry:
        requestMaxRetries: 1
        streamMaxRetries: 0
        baseDelayMs: 1
      models:
        m:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
